question: The Ministry of MSMEs in India celebrates the MSME Day on ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**27 June**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **MSME Day** is celebrated globally on **June 27** every year to recognize the importance of micro, small, and medium enterprises in sustainable development.
 
• The **United Nations General Assembly** declared June 27 as MSME Day in its 74th Plenary on April 6, 2017.
 
• In India, the Ministry of MSMEs organizes events and awareness programs to mark MSME Day and support the growth of small businesses.
 
• MSMEs are vital for the Indian economy, accounting for about **30% of GDP** and employing over **110 million people**.
 
• This day highlights the role of MSMEs in achieving the **United Nations Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs)** through innovation, job creation, and economic growth.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **MSME Definition:** Micro, Small, and Medium Enterprises are defined under the **MSME Act, 2006**, based on investment in plant/machinery and annual turnover.
 
• **Government Initiatives:** Schemes like **Udyam Registration, Credit Guarantee Fund Scheme, and the Prime Minister's Employment Generation Programme** (PMEGP) support MSMEs in India.
 
• **Challenges Faced:** MSMEs often face issues like **limited access to credit, lack of infrastructure, technological gaps, and market access.**
 
• **Global Recognition:** MSME Day emphasizes the need to provide financial and technical support to small businesses globally to foster inclusive and sustainable growth.
 
• **Digital Transformation:** Programs like **Digital MSME** aim to promote technology adoption among MSMEs to enhance productivity and global competitiveness.
